blocks.text: The module documentation distinguishes this API path from the CLI, describes tier behavior and turn recording, and imports the shared routing, agent, workspace, cache, safety, and persistence helpers.
blocks.title: API dispatch contract and imports

blocks.anchor: def _topic_scoped_task_text(workspace_id: str, topic_id: str, task_text: str,
blocks.text: Topic grounding reads covered sources and related notes, while generic grounding searches relevant nodes. Tier 0 and tier 1 execute fixed graphs and shape their results for the API.
blocks.title: Grounding and fixed tiers

blocks.anchor: def _run_tier3_hires(task_text: str, decision: dict, session_id: str, hires: list,
blocks.text: The hires-driven route sanitizes parallel groups, runs adaptive loops, handles pauses and degraded roles, optionally synthesizes multi-role output, collects artifacts, and returns a structured answer.
blocks.title: Adaptive tier-3 execution

blocks.anchor: def _write_plan_panels(response: dict, session_id: str, owner_id: str) -> None:
blocks.text: Completed tier-3 runs can write role output to plan panels and batch code files with findings, then emit refetch events. Quota reporting summarizes failed roles and ledger counters without gating the task.
blocks.title: Post-run persistence and quota summary

blocks.text: run_task records safe turns around the routing body, preview stops after staffing, confirm dispatches user-edited hires, and template runs classify from a saved workflow before dispatch.
blocks.title: Public task entry points

blocks.anchor: def _record_routing_fact(workspace_id: str, tier, task_text: str, session_id: str, decision: dict = None) -> None:
blocks.text: Routing facts store bounded task excerpts. Tier gates decide when to summarize content, profile signals are applied independently, and SGA answers can write a bounded workspace fact without a second LLM call.
blocks.title: Routing and durable fact helpers

blocks.anchor: def _workspace_grounding_and_cache_check(task_text: str, session_id: str, owner_id: str,
blocks.text: The cache helper computes workspace grounding and deterministic hits, while _try_cache_and_sga handles attachments, parallel fast-path SGA, generative references, cache writes, and escalation to Inspector classification.
blocks.title: Cache, attachment, and SGA resolution

blocks.anchor: def _resolve_decision_and_hires(task_text: str, tier_override: int, directed_task_type_override: str,
blocks.text: Resolution reuses precomputed fast-path data, classifies and staffs unresolved work, and applies mode gates. The inner runner dispatches grounded text, attaches suggestions, and tier 2 loads an app or executes a directed route.
blocks.title: Shared resolution and final tier dispatch

gotchas: The fast run_task path can resolve before content safety and transcript persistence; unresolved requests still take the safety gate.
Code write-back batches files, so one batch failure skips the whole persistence step.
Tier 2 requires both a directed task type and an existing app slug.

purpose: This module is the programmatic task-dispatch sibling of the CLI loop. It reuses classification and execution helpers, grounds notebook turns, supports preview, confirmation, and templates, records conversation and workspace facts, and returns JSON-shaped results rather than printing a final answer.
side_effects: LLM calls through SGA, agents, and summarization
